notes: Unit marks and topic scope are sourced from CBSE Secondary curriculum PDFs for 2025-26.
This registry is designed as a seed file for LazyTopper syllabus + content tracking tables.
v2 fix: Class X Maths 'Triangles' scope updated to match CBSE 2025-26 curriculum PDF; removed 'areas of similar triangles' and 'Pythagoras theorem' from assessed scope.

chapters.title: Real Numbers
cbse_scope_bullets: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic (statement, examples; review prior work).
Proofs of irrationality of √2, √3, √5 (and similar forms as indicated in curriculum competencies).

chapters.title: Polynomials
cbse_scope_bullets: Zeros of a polynomial (graphical & algebraic).
Relationship between zeros and coefficients of quadratic polynomials.

chapters.title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
cbse_scope_bullets: Graphical solution; consistency/inconsistency.
Algebraic conditions for number of solutions.
Algebraic solution by substitution and elimination; simple situational problems.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equations
cbse_scope_bullets: Standard form ax^2 + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0).
Solutions by factorization and quadratic formula (real roots only).
Discriminant and nature of roots.
Situational problems.

chapters.title: Arithmetic Progressions
cbse_scope_bullets: Motivation for studying AP.
Derivation of nth term and sum of first n terms; applications in daily life problems.

chapters.title: Coordinate Geometry
cbse_scope_bullets: Review of coordinate geometry concepts.
Distance formula.
Section formula (internal division).

chapters.title: Triangles
cbse_scope_bullets: Similar triangles: definitions, examples and counterexamples.
Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT): proof; and its converse (statement).

Similarity criteria statements (as per CBSE curriculum): (i) corresponding angles equal ⇒ sides proportional ⇒ triangles similar; (ii) corresponding sides proportional ⇒ corresponding angles equal ⇒ triangles similar; (iii) one angle equal and including sides proportional ⇒ triangles similar; and applications in problem solving.

chapters.title: Circles
cbse_scope_bullets: Tangent to a circle at a point; theorem (radius ⟂ tangent) and converse.
Number of tangents from an external point.

chapters.title: Trigonometry
cbse_scope_bullets: Trigonometric ratios of acute angles; values at 30°, 45°, 60°.
Trigonometric identities.
Heights and distances: angles of elevation/depression; simple problems with 30°,45°,60°.

chapters.title: Areas Related to Circles
cbse_scope_bullets: Area of a sector and segment of a circle.
Problems involving areas of combinations of plane figures (circle + polygon).

chapters.title: Surface Areas and Volumes
cbse_scope_bullets: Surface area and volume of combinations of cubes, cuboids, spheres, hemispheres, right circular cylinders and cones.

chapters.title: Statistics
cbse_scope_bullets: Mean, median, mode of grouped data (beyond simple cases).
Empirical relationship between mean, median and mode.

chapters.title: Probability
cbse_scope_bullets: Classical definition of probability.
Simple problems.

chapters.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
cbse_scope_bullets: Chemical reactions; chemical equations; balanced equations.
Types: combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement, precipitation, endothermic/exothermic, oxidation and reduction.

chapters.title: Acids, Bases and Salts
cbse_scope_bullets: Definitions in terms of H+ and OH– ions.
Indicators; chemical properties; neutralization; examples/uses.
pH scale (log definition not required); importance in everyday life.
Preparation and uses of sodium hydroxide, bleaching powder, baking soda, washing soda, plaster of Paris.

chapters.title: Metals and Non-metals
cbse_scope_bullets: Properties; reactivity series.
Ionic compounds: formation and properties.
Basic metallurgical processes.
Corrosion and prevention.

chapters.title: Carbon and its Compounds
cbse_scope_bullets: Covalent bonds: formation & properties.
Versatile nature of carbon; hydrocarbons (saturated/unsaturated); homologous series.
Nomenclature: alkanes, alkenes, alkyne; and functional groups (halogens, alcohol, ketones, aldehydes).
Reactions: combustion, oxidation, addition, substitution.
Ethanol and ethanoic acid (properties & uses).
Soaps and detergents.

chapters.title: Life Processes
cbse_scope_bullets: Living being; nutrition, respiration, transport, excretion in plants & animals.

chapters.title: Control and Co-ordination
cbse_scope_bullets: Tropic movements in plants; plant hormones (intro).
Animals: nervous system; voluntary/involuntary/reflex action.
Chemical coordination: animal hormones.

chapters.title: Reproduction
cbse_scope_bullets: Asexual and sexual reproduction in animals and plants.
Reproductive health: need and methods of family planning; safe sex vs HIV/AIDS; child bearing and women’s health.

chapters.title: Heredity and Evolution
cbse_scope_bullets: Heredity; Mendel’s contribution; laws for inheritance of traits.
Sex determination (brief introduction).

chapters.title: Light – Reflection and Refraction (incl. Human Eye, Prism)
cbse_scope_bullets: Reflection by curved surfaces; images by spherical mirrors; mirror formula (derivation not required); magnification.
Refraction; laws; refractive index.
Refraction by spherical lenses; lens formula (derivation not required); magnification; power of lens.
Human eye: functioning; defects and corrections; applications of mirrors and lenses.
Prism: refraction, dispersion; scattering; applications in daily life (excluding colour of sun at sunrise/sunset).

chapters.title: Electricity
cbse_scope_bullets: Electric current, potential difference, Ohm’s law.
Resistance, resistivity; factors.
Series/parallel combination; applications.
Heating effect; applications.
Electric power; relation among P, V, I, R.

chapters.title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
cbse_scope_bullets: Magnetic field and field lines.
Field due to current carrying conductor/coil/solenoid.
Force on current-carrying conductor; Fleming’s Left Hand Rule.
DC and AC (frequency); advantage of AC over DC; domestic circuits.

chapters.title: Our Environment
cbse_scope_bullets: Ecosystem; environmental problems; ozone depletion; waste production and solutions.
Biodegradable vs non-biodegradable.
